title: Binance Futures Copy Trading Adds New USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts (2024-10-29)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures Copy Trading will add the following USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts at  2024-10-29 09:00 (UTC) .  NEIROUSDT TURBOUSDT Experience Futures Copy Trading Now About Binance Futures Copy Trading Copy Trading allows users to copy experienced traders’ portfolios in real time. After determining the investment amount, the system will automatically copy trades from the lead traders’ portfolios that the users select. Novice traders may familiarize themselves with the crypto market via Copy Trading, and build up their strategizing and trading techniques.
